SELECT
  COALESCE(
    NULLIF(TRIM(CONCAT_WS(' ', person.First_Name, person.Middle_Name, person.Last_Name)), ''),
    organizations.Organization_Name
  ) AS Agent_Name,
  policy.Policy_Number,
  claim.Claim_Identifier,
  catastrophe.Catastrophe_Name
FROM agreement_party_role AS apr
JOIN party_role AS pr
  ON pr.Party_Role_Code = apr.Party_Role_Code
JOIN party
  ON party.Party_Identifier = apr.Party_Identifier
LEFT JOIN person
  ON person.Person_Identifier = party.Party_Identifier
LEFT JOIN organizations
  ON organizations.Organization_Identifier = party.Party_Identifier
JOIN policy
  ON policy.Policy_Identifier = apr.Agreement_Identifier
JOIN policy_coverage_detail AS pcd
  ON pcd.Policy_Identifier = policy.Policy_Identifier
JOIN claim_coverage AS cc
  ON cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
JOIN claim
  ON claim.Claim_Identifier = cc.Claim_Identifier
JOIN catastrophe
  ON catastrophe.Catastrophe_Identifier = claim.Catastrophe_Identifier
WHERE LOWER(pr.Party_Role_Name) = 'agent';

SELECT
  c.Company_Claim_Number AS claim_number,
  SUM(ca.Claim_Amount) AS total_loss_amount
FROM (
  SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM loss_payment
  UNION ALL
  SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM loss_reserve
) AS loss_amounts
JOIN claim_amount AS ca
  ON ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier = loss_amounts.Claim_Amount_Identifier
JOIN claim AS c
  ON c.Claim_Identifier = ca.Claim_Identifier
GROUP BY c.Company_Claim_Number;

answer.sql:
WITH claim_amounts AS (
    SELECT
        ca.Claim_Identifier,
        SUM(CASE WHEN lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END) AS loss_payment_amount,
        SUM(CASE WHEN lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END) AS loss_reserve_amount,
        SUM(CASE WHEN ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END) AS expense_payment_amount,
        SUM(CASE WHEN er.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END) AS expense_reserve_amount
    FROM claim_amount ca
    LEFT JOIN loss_payment lp ON lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    LEFT JOIN loss_reserve lr ON lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    LEFT JOIN expense_payment ep ON ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    LEFT JOIN expense_reserve er ON er.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    GROUP BY ca.Claim_Identifier
),
claim_policies AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        cc.Claim_Identifier,
        p.Policy_Identifier,
        p.Policy_Number
    FROM claim_coverage cc
    JOIN policy_coverage_detail pcd
        ON pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
    JOIN policy p
        ON p.Policy_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Identifier
),
policy_premiums AS (
    SELECT
        pa.Policy_Identifier,
        SUM(pa.Policy_Amount) AS premium_amount_paid
    FROM policy_amount pa
    JOIN premium pr
        ON pr.Policy_Amount_Identifier = pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier
    GROUP BY pa.Policy_Identifier
),
policy_parties AS (
    SELECT
        apr.Agreement_Identifier AS Policy_Identifier,
        MAX(CASE
            WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(p_role.Party_Role_Name, apr.Party_Role_Code)) LIKE '%holder%'
              OR LOWER(COALESCE(p_role.Party_Role_Name, apr.Party_Role_Code)) LIKE '%insured%'
            THEN party.Party_Name
        END) AS policy_holder,
        MAX(CASE
            WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(p_role.Party_Role_Name, apr.Party_Role_Code)) LIKE '%agent%'
              OR LOWER(COALESCE(p_role.Party_Role_Name, apr.Party_Role_Code)) LIKE '%producer%'
            THEN party.Party_Name
        END) AS agent
    FROM agreement_party_role apr
    LEFT JOIN party_role p_role
        ON p_role.Party_Role_Code = apr.Party_Role_Code
    LEFT JOIN party
        ON party.Party_Identifier = apr.Party_Identifier
    GROUP BY apr.Agreement_Identifier
)
SELECT
    c.Company_Claim_Number AS claim_number,
    cp.Policy_Number AS policy_number,
    pp.policy_holder,
    COALESCE(ca.loss_payment_amount, 0) AS loss_payment_amount,
    COALESCE(ca.loss_reserve_amount, 0) AS loss_reserve_amount,
    COALESCE(ca.expense_payment_amount, 0) AS expense_payment_amount,
    COALESCE(ca.expense_reserve_amount, 0) AS expense_reserve_amount,
    COALESCE(prem.premium_amount_paid, 0) AS premium_amount_paid,
    pp.agent
FROM claim c
JOIN claim_policies cp
    ON cp.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
LEFT JOIN claim_amounts ca
    ON ca.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
LEFT JOIN policy_premiums prem
    ON prem.Policy_Identifier = cp.Policy_Identifier
LEFT JOIN policy_parties pp
    ON pp.Policy_Identifier = cp.Policy_Identifier;

SELECT DISTINCT
  p.Policy_Number,
  apr.Party_Identifier AS Agent_ID
FROM policy AS p
JOIN agreement_party_role AS apr
  ON apr.Agreement_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
JOIN party_role AS pr
  ON pr.Party_Role_Code = apr.Party_Role_Code
WHERE LOWER(TRIM(pr.Party_Role_Name)) = 'agent';

WITH claim_settlement_times AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    p.Policy_Number,
    c.Claim_Identifier,
    date_diff('day', c.Claim_Open_Date, c.Claim_Close_Date) AS settlement_days
  FROM claim AS c
  JOIN claim_coverage AS cc
    ON cc.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
  JOIN policy_coverage_detail AS pcd
    ON pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
  JOIN policy AS p
    ON p.Policy_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Identifier
  WHERE c.Claim_Open_Date IS NOT NULL
    AND c.Claim_Close_Date IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  Policy_Number,
  AVG(settlement_days) AS average_time_to_settle_days
FROM claim_settlement_times
GROUP BY Policy_Number
ORDER BY Policy_Number;

SELECT
    c.Company_Claim_Number AS claim_number,
    SUM(ca.Claim_Amount) AS total_loss
FROM claim AS c
JOIN claim_amount AS ca
    ON ca.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
WHERE ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier IN (
    SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM loss_payment
    UNION
    SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM loss_reserve
    UNION
    SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM expense_payment
    UNION
    SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM expense_reserve
)
GROUP BY c.Company_Claim_Number;

SELECT SUM(pa.Policy_Amount) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT pa.Policy_Identifier) AS average_policy_size
FROM premium AS p
JOIN policy_amount AS pa
  ON pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier = p.Policy_Amount_Identifier;

SELECT
  p.Policy_Identifier,
  apr.Party_Identifier AS Policy_Holder_ID
FROM policy AS p
LEFT JOIN agreement_party_role AS apr
  ON apr.Agreement_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM party_role AS pr
    WHERE pr.Party_Role_Code = apr.Party_Role_Code
      AND lower(pr.Party_Role_Name) IN ('policy holder', 'policyholder')
  );

WITH loss_amount_ids AS (
    SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM loss_payment
    UNION ALL
    SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM loss_reserve
    UNION ALL
    SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM expense_payment
    UNION ALL
    SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM expense_reserve
),
claim_loss AS (
    SELECT
        ca.Claim_Identifier,
        SUM(ca.Claim_Amount) AS total_loss
    FROM claim_amount AS ca
    JOIN loss_amount_ids AS lai
        ON lai.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    GROUP BY ca.Claim_Identifier
),
claim_policy AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        cc.Claim_Identifier,
        p.Policy_Number
    FROM claim_coverage AS cc
    JOIN policy_coverage_detail AS pcd
        ON pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
       AND pcd.Effective_Date = cc.Effective_Date
    JOIN policy AS p
        ON p.Policy_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Identifier
)
SELECT
    c.Company_Claim_Number AS claim_number,
    cat.Catastrophe_Name AS catastrophe,
    cp.Policy_Number AS policy_number,
    SUM(cl.total_loss) AS total_loss
FROM claim_loss AS cl
JOIN claim AS c
    ON c.Claim_Identifier = cl.Claim_Identifier
JOIN catastrophe AS cat
    ON cat.Catastrophe_Identifier = c.Catastrophe_Identifier
JOIN claim_policy AS cp
    ON cp.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
GROUP BY
    c.Company_Claim_Number,
    cat.Catastrophe_Name,
    cp.Policy_Number;

SELECT SUM(pa.Policy_Amount) AS total_premiums_paid
FROM policy_amount AS pa
JOIN premium AS p
  ON p.Policy_Amount_Identifier = pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier;

WITH claim_policy AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    cc.Claim_Identifier,
    p.Policy_Number
  FROM claim_coverage AS cc
  JOIN policy_coverage_detail AS pcd
    ON pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
   AND pcd.Effective_Date = cc.Effective_Date
  JOIN policy AS p
    ON p.Policy_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Identifier
)
SELECT
  cat.Catastrophe_Identifier,
  cat.Catastrophe_Name,
  cp.Policy_Number,
  SUM(ca.Claim_Amount) AS Total_Loss
FROM claim AS c
JOIN catastrophe AS cat
  ON cat.Catastrophe_Identifier = c.Catastrophe_Identifier
JOIN claim_policy AS cp
  ON cp.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
JOIN claim_amount AS ca
  ON ca.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
WHERE
  EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM loss_payment AS lp
    WHERE lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
  )
  OR EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM loss_reserve AS lr
    WHERE lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
  )
  OR EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM expense_payment AS ep
    WHERE ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
  )
  OR EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM expense_reserve AS er
    WHERE er.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
  )
GROUP BY
  cat.Catastrophe_Identifier,
  cat.Catastrophe_Name,
  cp.Policy_Number;

SELECT

answer.sql:
WITH party_names AS (
    SELECT
        p.Party_Identifier,
        COALESCE(
            NULLIF(TRIM(CONCAT_WS(' ', pe.First_Name, pe.Middle_Name, pe.Last_Name)), ''),
            o.Organization_Name,
            CAST(p.Party_Name AS VARCHAR)
        ) AS Party_Name
    FROM party p
    LEFT JOIN person pe
        ON pe.Person_Identifier = p.Party_Identifier
    LEFT JOIN organizations o
        ON o.Organization_Identifier = p.Party_Identifier
),
agreement_roles AS (
    SELECT
        apr.Agreement_Identifier,
        STRING_AGG(DISTINCT CASE
            WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(pr.Party_Role_Name, '') || ' ' || COALESCE(apr.Party_Role_Code, '')) LIKE '%holder%'
              OR LOWER(COALESCE(pr.Party_Role_Name, '') || ' ' || COALESCE(apr.Party_Role_Code, '')) LIKE '%insured%'
            THEN pn.Party_Name
        END, ', ') AS Policy_Holder,
        STRING_AGG(DISTINCT CASE
            WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(pr.Party_Role_Name, '') || ' ' || COALESCE(apr.Party_Role_Code, '')) LIKE '%agent%'
              OR LOWER(COALESCE(pr.Party_Role_Name, '') || ' ' || COALESCE(apr.Party_Role_Code, '')) LIKE '%producer%'
            THEN pn.Party_Name
        END, ', ') AS Agent
    FROM agreement_party_role apr
    LEFT JOIN party_role pr
        ON pr.Party_Role_Code = apr.Party_Role_Code
    LEFT JOIN party_names pn
        ON pn.Party_Identifier = apr.Party_Identifier
    GROUP BY apr.Agreement_Identifier
),
claim_amounts AS (
    SELECT
        ca.Claim_Identifier,
        SUM(CASE WHEN lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount END) AS Loss_Payment_Amount,
        SUM(CASE WHEN lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount END) AS Loss_Reserve_Amount,
        SUM(CASE WHEN ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount END) AS Expense_Payment_Amount,
        SUM(CASE WHEN er.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount END) AS Expense_Reserve_Amount
    FROM claim_amount ca
    LEFT JOIN loss_payment lp
        ON lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    LEFT JOIN loss_reserve lr
        ON lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    LEFT JOIN expense_payment ep
        ON ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    LEFT JOIN expense_reserve er
        ON er.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    GROUP BY ca.Claim_Identifier
),
premium_amounts AS (
    SELECT
        pa.Policy_Identifier,
        SUM(pa.Policy_Amount) AS Premium_Amount_Paid
    FROM policy_amount pa
    JOIN premium prem
        ON prem.Policy_Amount_Identifier = pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier
    GROUP BY pa.Policy_Identifier
)
SELECT
    c.Company_Claim_Number AS Claim_Number,
    pol.Policy_Number,
    ar.Policy_Holder,
    COALESCE(ca.Loss_Payment_Amount, 0) AS Loss_Payment_Amount,
    COALESCE(ca.Loss_Reserve_Amount, 0) AS Loss_Reserve_Amount,
    COALESCE(ca.Expense_Payment_Amount, 0) AS Expense_Payment_Amount,
    COALESCE(ca.Expense_Reserve_Amount, 0) AS Expense_Reserve_Amount,
    COALESCE(pa.Premium_Amount_Paid, 0) AS Premium_Amount_Paid,
    cat.Catastrophe_Name,
    ar.Agent
FROM claim c
LEFT JOIN claim_amounts ca
    ON ca.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
LEFT JOIN catastrophe cat
    ON cat.Catastrophe_Identifier = c.Catastrophe_Identifier
JOIN claim_coverage cc
    ON cc.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
JOIN policy_coverage_detail pcd
    ON pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
   AND pcd.Effective_Date = cc.Effective_Date
JOIN policy pol
    ON pol.Policy_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Identifier
LEFT JOIN premium_amounts pa
    ON pa.Policy_Identifier = pol.Policy_Identifier
LEFT JOIN agreement_roles ar
    ON ar.Agreement_Identifier = pol.Policy_Identifier;

answer.sql:
SELECT
  apr.Party_Identifier AS policy_holder_id,
  COUNT(DISTINCT p.Policy_Identifier) AS policy_count
FROM policy AS p
JOIN agreement_party_role AS apr
  ON apr.Agreement_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
JOIN party_role AS pr
  ON pr.Party_Role_Code = apr.Party_Role_Code
WHERE LOWER(pr.Party_Role_Name) = 'policy holder'
GROUP BY apr.Party_Identifier;

SELECT
  p.Policy_Number,
  COUNT(DISTINCT c.Claim_Identifier) AS Claim_Count
FROM claim AS c
JOIN claim_coverage AS cc
  ON cc.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
JOIN policy_coverage_detail AS pcd
  ON pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
JOIN policy AS p
  ON p.Policy_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Identifier
GROUP BY p.Policy_Number;

WITH policy_claim AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    p.Policy_Identifier,
    p.Policy_Number,
    c.Claim_Identifier
  FROM policy AS p
  JOIN policy_coverage_detail AS pcd
    ON pcd.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
  JOIN claim_coverage AS cc
    ON cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
  JOIN claim AS c
    ON c.Claim_Identifier = cc.Claim_Identifier
),
claim_loss AS (
  SELECT
    pc.Policy_Identifier,
    pc.Policy_Number,
    pc.Claim_Identifier,
    COALESCE(
      SUM(
        CASE
          WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM loss_payment AS lp
            WHERE lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
          )
          OR EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM loss_reserve AS lr
            WHERE lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
          )
          OR EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM expense_payment AS ep
            WHERE ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
          )
          OR EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM expense_reserve AS er
            WHERE er.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
          )
          THEN ca.Claim_Amount
          ELSE 0
        END
      ),
      0
    ) AS Loss
  FROM policy_claim AS pc
  LEFT JOIN claim_amount AS ca
    ON ca.Claim_Identifier = pc.Claim_Identifier
  GROUP BY
    pc.Policy_Identifier,
    pc.Policy_Number,
    pc.Claim_Identifier
)
SELECT
  Policy_Number,
  COUNT(*) AS Number_Of_Claims,
  AVG(Loss) AS Average_Loss
FROM claim_loss
GROUP BY
  Policy_Identifier,
  Policy_Number;

SELECT
  p.Policy_Number,
  SUM(pa.Policy_Amount) AS total_premiums_paid
FROM premium AS pr
JOIN policy_amount AS pa
  ON pr.Policy_Amount_Identifier = pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier
JOIN policy AS p
  ON pa.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
GROUP BY p.Policy_Number;

SELECT pa.Policy_Amount
FROM premium AS p
JOIN policy_amount AS pa
  ON p.Policy_Amount_Identifier = pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier;

SELECT
  c.Company_Claim_Number AS Claim_Number,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM loss_payment lp
    WHERE lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
  ) THEN ca.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS Loss_Payment,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM loss_reserve lr
    WHERE lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
  ) THEN ca.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS Loss_Reserve,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM expense_payment ep
    WHERE ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
  ) THEN ca.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS Expense_Payment,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM expense_reserve er
    WHERE er.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
  ) THEN ca.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS Expense_Reserve
FROM claim c
LEFT JOIN claim_amount ca
  ON ca.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
GROUP BY c.Company_Claim_Number

WITH categorized_claim_amounts AS (
  SELECT ca.Claim_Identifier, ca.Claim_Amount
  FROM claim_amount ca
  JOIN loss_payment lp
    ON lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier

  UNION ALL

  SELECT ca.Claim_Identifier, ca.Claim_Amount
  FROM claim_amount ca
  JOIN loss_reserve lr
    ON lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier

  UNION ALL

  SELECT ca.Claim_Identifier, ca.Claim_Amount
  FROM claim_amount ca
  JOIN expense_payment ep
    ON ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier

  UNION ALL

  SELECT ca.Claim_Identifier, ca.Claim_Amount
  FROM claim_amount ca
  JOIN expense_reserve er
    ON er.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
),
loss_by_claim AS (
  SELECT Claim_Identifier, SUM(Claim_Amount) AS Total_Loss
  FROM categorized_claim_amounts
  GROUP BY Claim_Identifier
),
premium_by_policy AS (
  SELECT pa.Policy_Identifier, SUM(pa.Policy_Amount) AS Premium_Amount_Paid
  FROM policy_amount pa
  JOIN premium prem
    ON prem.Policy_Amount_Identifier = pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier
  GROUP BY pa.Policy_Identifier
),
policy_holders AS (
  SELECT
    apr.Agreement_Identifier AS Policy_Identifier,
    STRING_AGG(
      DISTINCT COALESCE(
        NULLIF(TRIM(CONCAT_WS(' ', pe.First_Name, pe.Middle_Name, pe.Last_Name)), ''),
        org.Organization_Name,
        CAST(p.Party_Name AS VARCHAR)
      ),
      ', '
    ) AS Policy_Holder
  FROM agreement_party_role apr
  JOIN party_role pr
    ON pr.Party_Role_Code = apr.Party_Role_Code
  JOIN party p
    ON p.Party_Identifier = apr.Party_Identifier
  LEFT JOIN person pe
    ON pe.Person_Identifier = apr.Party_Identifier
  LEFT JOIN organizations org
    ON org.Organization_Identifier = apr.Party_Identifier
  WHERE LOWER(pr.Party_Role_Name) LIKE '%holder%'
     OR LOWER(pr.Party_Role_Name) IN ('insured', 'named insured')
  GROUP BY apr.Agreement_Identifier
)
SELECT
  c.Company_Claim_Number AS Claim_Number,
  pol.Policy_Number,
  ph.Policy_Holder,
  pp.Premium_Amount_Paid,
  COALESCE(lbc.Total_Loss, 0) AS Total_Loss
FROM claim c
JOIN claim_coverage cc
  ON cc.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
JOIN policy_coverage_detail pcd
  ON pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
 AND pcd.Effective_Date = cc.Effective_Date
JOIN policy pol
  ON pol.Policy_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Identifier
LEFT JOIN loss_by_claim lbc
  ON lbc.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
LEFT JOIN premium_by_policy pp
  ON pp.Policy_Identifier = pol.Policy_Identifier
LEFT JOIN policy_holders ph
  ON ph.Policy_Identifier = pol.Policy_Identifier;

WITH claim_policy AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        c.Claim_Identifier,
        c.Company_Claim_Number,

    FROM claim AS c
    JOIN claim_coverage AS cc
        ON cc.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
    JOIN policy_coverage_detail AS pcd
        ON pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
    JOIN policy AS p
        ON p.Policy_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Identifier
),
claim_amounts AS (
    SELECT
        ca.Claim_Identifier,
        SUM(CASE WHEN lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END) AS Loss_Payment_Amount,
        SUM(CASE WHEN lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END) AS Loss_Reserve_Amount,
        SUM(CASE WHEN ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END) AS Expense_Payment_Amount,
        SUM(CASE WHEN er.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END) AS Expense_Reserve_Amount
    FROM claim_amount AS ca
    LEFT JOIN loss_payment AS lp
        ON lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    LEFT JOIN loss_reserve AS lr
        ON lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    LEFT JOIN expense_payment AS ep
        ON ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    LEFT JOIN expense_reserve AS er
        ON er.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    GROUP BY ca.Claim_Identifier
),
policy_premiums AS (
    SELECT
        pa.Policy_Identifier,
        SUM(pa.Policy_Amount) AS Premium_Amount_Paid
    FROM policy_amount AS pa
    JOIN premium AS pr
        ON pr.Policy_Amount_Identifier = pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier
    GROUP BY pa.Policy_Identifier
),
policy_holders AS (
    SELECT
        apr.Agreement_Identifier AS Policy_Identifier,
        STRING_AGG(
            DISTINCT COALESCE(
                o.Organization_Name,
                NULLIF(TRIM(CONCAT_WS(' ', pe.First_Name, pe.Middle_Name, pe.Last_Name)), ''),
                CAST(party.Party_Name AS VARCHAR),
                CAST(party.Party_Identifier AS VARCHAR)
            ),
            ', '
        ) AS Policy_Holder
    FROM agreement_party_role AS apr
    JOIN party_role AS pr
        ON pr.Party_Role_Code = apr.Party_Role_Code
    JOIN party
        ON party.Party_Identifier = apr.Party_Identifier
    LEFT JOIN organizations AS o
        ON o.Organization_Identifier = party.Party_Identifier
    LEFT JOIN person AS pe
        ON pe.Person_Identifier = party.Party_Identifier
    WHERE LOWER(pr.Party_Role_Name) LIKE '%policy%holder%'
       OR LOWER(pr.Party_Role_Name) LIKE '%named insured%'
    GROUP BY apr.Agreement_Identifier
)
SELECT
    cp.Company_Claim_Number AS Claim_Number,
    cp.Policy_Number,
    ph.Policy_Holder,
    COALESCE(ca.Loss_Payment_Amount, 0) AS Loss_Payment_Amount,
    COALESCE(ca.Loss_Reserve_Amount, 0) AS Loss_Reserve_Amount,
    COALESCE(ca.Expense_Payment_Amount, 0) AS Expense_Payment_Amount,
    COALESCE(ca.Expense_Reserve_Amount, 0) AS Expense_Reserve_Amount,
    COALESCE(pp.Premium_Amount_Paid, 0) AS Premium_Amount_Paid
FROM claim_policy AS cp
LEFT JOIN claim_amounts AS ca
    ON ca.Claim_Identifier = cp.Claim_Identifier
LEFT JOIN policy_premiums AS pp
    ON pp.Policy_Identifier = cp.Policy_Identifier
LEFT JOIN policy_holders AS ph
    ON ph.Policy_Identifier = cp.Policy_Identifier;

SELECT
  apr.Party_Identifier AS agent_id,
  p.Policy_Number,
  c.Company_Claim_Number AS claim_number,
  SUM(ca.Claim_Amount) AS loss_payment_amount
FROM policy AS p
JOIN agreement_party_role AS apr
  ON apr.Agreement_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
JOIN party_role AS pr
  ON pr.Party_Role_Code = apr.Party_Role_Code
JOIN policy_coverage_detail AS pcd
  ON pcd.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
JOIN claim_coverage AS cc
  ON cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
JOIN claim AS c
  ON c.Claim_Identifier = cc.Claim_Identifier
JOIN claim_amount AS ca
  ON ca.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
JOIN loss_payment AS lp
  ON lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
WHERE LOWER(TRIM(pr.Party_Role_Name)) = 'agent'
GROUP BY
  apr.Party_Identifier,
  p.Policy_Number,
  c.Company_Claim_Number;

SELECT
  p.Policy_Number,
  pcd.Effective_Date AS Coverage_Effective_Date,
  pcd.Expiration_Date AS Coverage_Expiration_Date,
  SUM(pa.Policy_Amount) AS Premium_Amount
FROM policy AS p
JOIN policy_coverage_detail AS pcd
  ON pcd.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
JOIN policy_amount AS pa
  ON pa.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
  AND pa.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier

  ON prem.Policy_Amount_Identifier = pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier
GROUP BY
  p.Policy_Number,
  pcd.Effective_Date,
  pcd.Expiration_Date
ORDER BY
  p.Policy_Number,
  pcd.Effective_Date,
  pcd.Expiration_Date;

WITH claim_policy AS (

        cc.Claim_Identifier,
        pcd.Policy_Identifier
    FROM claim_coverage AS cc
    JOIN policy_coverage_detail AS pcd
        ON pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
),
claim_counts AS (
    SELECT
        Policy_Identifier,
        COUNT(DISTINCT Claim_Identifier) AS Number_Of_Claims
    FROM claim_policy
    GROUP BY Policy_Identifier
),
loss_amounts AS (
    SELECT
        ca.Claim_Identifier,
        ca.Claim_Amount
    FROM claim_amount AS ca
    WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM loss_payment AS lp
        WHERE lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    )
    OR EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM loss_reserve AS lr
        WHERE lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    )
    OR EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM expense_payment AS ep
        WHERE ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    )
    OR EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM expense_reserve AS er
        WHERE er.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    )
),
policy_losses AS (
    SELECT
        cp.Policy_Identifier,
        SUM(la.Claim_Amount) AS Total_Loss
    FROM claim_policy AS cp
    JOIN loss_amounts AS la
        ON la.Claim_Identifier = cp.Claim_Identifier
    GROUP BY cp.Policy_Identifier
),
policy_premiums AS (
    SELECT
        pa.Policy_Identifier,
        SUM(pa.Policy_Amount) AS Premium
    FROM policy_amount AS pa
    JOIN premium AS pr
        ON pr.Policy_Amount_Identifier = pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier
    GROUP BY pa.Policy_Identifier
)
SELECT
    p.Policy_Number,
    COALESCE(pp.Premium, 0) AS Premium,
    cc.Number_Of_Claims,
    COALESCE(pl.Total_Loss, 0) AS Total_Loss,
    CAST(COALESCE(pl.Total_Loss, 0) AS DOUBLE)
        / NULLIF(CAST(pp.Premium AS DOUBLE), 0) AS Loss_Ratio
FROM claim_counts AS cc
JOIN policy AS p
    ON p.Policy_Identifier = cc.Policy_Identifier
LEFT JOIN policy_premiums AS pp
    ON pp.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
LEFT JOIN policy_losses AS pl
    ON pl.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier;
